messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: metric=5xx_rate service=gateway env=prod region=eu-west1 window=5m threshold=3% current=8.4% — PagerDuty ticket PD-4821 created and auto-paged oncall.

maria (oncall): ack. I'm on it, switching to incident channel.

maria (oncall): quick check — dashboard shows a sharp 502/504 spike starting ~2259012000, traffic steady. Tail of 5xx is mostly proxy upstream reset.

maria (oncall): grabbing logs from edge-proxy and gateway pods.

maria (oncall): ```bash
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/gateway -c gateway --since=10m | grep "502" | head -n 40
# many lines with "upstream connection reset by peer" and "http: response.WriteHeader called more than once"
```

raj (sre-lead): pinging — could be LB healthcheck churn or a burst of long-tail requests causing connection pool exhaustion. Any recent deploys?

maria (oncall): no user-facing deploys in the last 40m. There was a small infra job from tj ~45m ago that reloaded envoy config for canary routing.

tj (infra): I restarted envoy canary cluster for cfg rollout, but only to canary hosts. Nothing that should affect all traffic. I have logs too, checking upstream TCP resets.

maria (oncall): reproducing pattern: when a model-router returns slow 1xx/timeout, gateway connections pile up and upstream resets hit envoy -> 502s. Looks like conn pool not recycling fast enough.

sam (product): any known customers impacted? Observability shows 2% of requests are erroring but some dashboards show degraded latency for top customers in eu-west1. I'm drafting an incident banner.

maria (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) scale gateway replicas + autoscaler target temporarily, 2) open a circuit to route a fraction of traffic to fallback model variant, 3) bump connection pool limits on envoy if safe, 4) rollback canary if evidence points to env config.

pagerduty-bot: PD-4821 auto-escalated to raj after 3m with no ack from primary (already acked by maria).

raj (sre-lead): agree. Step 1: scaling gateway now. Running: ```kubectl -n inference scale deploy/gateway --replicas=6```

maria (oncall): scaling in progress. Meanwhile disabling preflight warmup that keeps long-lived model proxy connections open (temp). Command: ```kubectl -n inference set env deploy/model-router DISABLE_PREFLIGHT=1```

tj (infra): increasing envoy upstream connections and circuit settings. Patch applied via configmap v2026. Restarting canary envoy instances.

maria (oncall): applying temporary traffic split to fallback-model (10%) via routing: ```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" "https://controlplane/api/v1/route/split" -d '{"target":"fallback-model","percent":10,"region":"eu-west1"}'```

maria (oncall): after scale + routing, 5xx dropped to ~1.6% within 90s. Latency improving for affected requests.

sam (product): pushing an incident banner to status page: "Partial errors (5xx) observed in eu-west1, small portion of requests routed to fallback. Mitigation in progress."

maria (oncall): monitoring for 10m. If stable, we'll keep fallback enabled and rollback any envoy canary that touched global config.

tj (infra): I see one of the model-router pools with high GC pauses causing slow responses — increasing JVM heap and restarting that pool. Restart completed, instance warmed.

raj (sre-lead): good. Next: capture heap/profile, and add circuit-breaker metrics to alert thresholds. We'll also add short-term autoscaling tweak to be less conservative for burst.

maria (oncall): PD-4821 annotated with mitigation steps and will remain acknowledged. Notifying CS for customers who hit >5% failure by account.

ops-bot: external probe check count shows recovery: eu-west1 5xx_rate=1.3% (down from 8.4%).

maria (oncall): rolling back envoy canary cluster change to be safe. Command run.

maria (oncall): verifying no regression in canary after rollback. All checks green.

raj (sre-lead): recommend post-incident actions: 1) revert aggressive preflight behavior that's keeping connections open, 2) tune connection pool and retry backoff, 3) run a forced scale test in staging to validate autoscaler under burst, 4) add better upstream-reset dashboards and a runbook link.

maria (oncall): creating follow-up ticket INF-1283 for the TODOs and scheduling a postmortem call tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

sam (product): customer impact note posted to PD ticket and status page updated.

maria (oncall): closing pager — root cause seems to be a combination of transient model-router slowness (GC/heap pressure) + an envoy canary change that reduced effective pool headroom. Mitigation: scale, fallback routing, restart model pool, rollback canary.

incident-bot: Pager resolved: PD-4821 closed by maria at 2259013200.

maria (oncall): thanks team. Follow-ups in INF-1283. :thumbsup:
